title: feat(ai-report): AI executive-summary MVP with sanitized bundle + provider abstraction
body:
## Summary

First, small, safe slice of AI report enhancement: an **executive-summary-only**, **safe-mode** endpoint that turns scanner findings into a reviewable draft via an external LLM — without ever leaking secrets, raw JS bodies, or PII to the provider. Includes the full architecture design doc for the broader feature; everything beyond the summary is roadmap.

**The safety boundary is the whole point.** The LLM never sees the job/summary JSON. It sees a sanitized bundle built by two independent layers, so a single mistake can't leak:
1. **Allowlist** — only the 13 contract fields (`finding_id`, `rule_id`, `title`, `category`, `severity`, `confidence`, `url`, `evidence_snippet`, `evidence_type`, `source_file`, `validation_pipeline`, `public_or_secret`, `scanner_reason`) can enter a bundle entry.
2. **Redaction pass** (`scrub_text`) over every surviving string — JWTs, emails, AWS/GCP/GitHub/Slack/Stripe/OpenAI key shapes, `Authorization`/`Cookie` headers, session IDs, magic-link/token query params, long opaque blobs, and internal filesystem paths (`/root`, `/home`, …). `source_file` is reduced to a basename. URL hosts/paths are deliberately preserved (they're core evidence).

```
POST /api/jobs/{id}/ai-report  {feature:"executive_summary"}
  auth + CSRF + ownership → status in (completed,partial) → rate-limit 5/5min
  → build_finding_bundle(include_owner_values=False)   # safe mode
  → bundle_hash(bundle, feature, model) → redis cache (best-effort, 7d)
  → provider = get_provider()   # None ⇒ 503 ai_feature_disabled
  → generate_executive_summary()  # 1 retry, citation guardrail
  → audit log → cache store → JSON {summary, model, usage, cited_finding_ids,
                                    hallucinated_finding_ids, needs_review, ...}
```

**Provider abstraction** (`get_provider()`): env-configured (`AI_REPORT_PROVIDER`, `AI_REPORT_API_KEY`, `AI_REPORT_MODEL`, `AI_REPORT_BASE_URL`). `openai` = Chat-Completions-compatible via stdlib `urllib` (no new dependency; also covers OpenRouter/local servers). `stub` = deterministic, network-free, used by tests. **With no key configured, `get_provider()` returns `None` and the endpoint returns `503 ai_feature_disabled` — so this PR is inert in prod until explicitly enabled, and CI/tests never call a real LLM.**

**Guardrail:** the model is instructed to cite `[finding_id]` for every claim and say "Not enough evidence" rather than speculate. Post-generation, any cited ID not present in the bundle is collected into `hallucinated_finding_ids` and flips `needs_review=true`.

Explicitly **out of scope** (designed in the doc, not built): per-finding explanations, bug-bounty report draft, clustering, sensitive-evidence mode, frontend UI, RQ async path, auto-submission (there is no code path that sends output anywhere external).

## Files
- `saas/ai_report.py` — sanitizer, `build_finding_bundle`, `bundle_hash`, prompts, providers, `generate_executive_summary`.
- `saas/app.py` — `POST /api/jobs/{job_id}/ai-report` (+ `AIReportRequest`, `AI_REPORT_CACHE_TTL`).
- `tests/test_ai_report.py` — 13 tests: scrub redacts each secret class, bundle allowlist + no-leak, finding cap/severity order, hash stability, provider gating (disabled by default, openai needs key, stub works), citation + hallucination detection, endpoint disabled→503 and stub→200 with no leak.
- `docs/AI_REPORT_ENHANCEMENT.md` — full architecture + MVP recommendation.

## Tests run
- `python -m py_compile saas/ai_report.py saas/app.py` — OK
- `python -m unittest tests.test_ai_report` — 13/13 pass
- `python -m unittest` (full) — 669 tests, only failure is the **preexisting** `test_backup_db` gzip error (reproduces on `main`, unrelated)
- `git diff --check` — clean
- Frontend untouched (`git diff --stat main -- frontend/` empty). The 4 `npm run lint` errors in `JSIntelligence.tsx` are **preexisting** (`as any` on `source_map_discovery_debug`, merged in #109) and not part of this branch.

## Manual retest
```
# disabled by default
curl -XPOST .../api/jobs/<id>/ai-report   # -> 503 ai_feature_disabled
# enable with a real provider
export AI_REPORT_PROVIDER=openai AI_REPORT_API_KEY=sk-... AI_REPORT_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
curl -XPOST .../api/jobs/<id>/ai-report -d '{"feature":"executive_summary"}'
```
